text:
Marta V: Heads up — AP-SE2 fleet seeing failed attestation after a secure-boot toggle during last night's firmware push, provisioning jobs stuck and GPUs in ALLOCATING state.
Leo K: Confirmed. Mgmt-plane metrics show bandwidth shaping/policer hitting ~480-520pps per-host, we start dropping requests.
Sanjay P: Seeing repeated TLS retries to KMS/HSM during key rotation too, 429/504 spikes around the same window. Might be combined load + short-lived conn churn.
InfraBot: deploybot: firmware-rollout job 4823 paused at 03:12 UTC due to 429 from mgmt-api (service=attest, code=429).
Alejandra: Impact: ~120 GPUs tied up across 6 racks in ap-se2, Q for customer A tomorrow will be underprovisioned if we don't recover ~60 GPUs.
Marta V: Can we revert the secure-boot flag on the canary image and resume?
Leo K: Recommend: pause global rollout, increase mgmt-api burst for rollout service, and run focused attestation retries with backoff. Also add extra jitter to retries so KMS doesn't get thundering herd.
Sanjay P: Quick commands I ran: ```curl -v -X POST 'https://mgmt-api.internal/v1/attest/retry' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -d '{"rack":"ap-se2","limit":50}'``` and ```mgmtctl metrics top --svc rollout --window 1m```. Also ipmi snippet to inspect BMC: ```ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc-rack05-node03 -U admin -P **** sel elist```
Alejandra: Don't clear SEL before we archive it. Run `ipmitool sel elist > sel.rack05.node03.log && tar czf sel-node03.tgz sel.rack05.node03.log`
Marta V: Doing canary rollback on 3 racks now (rack05, rack07, rack09).
Ops Oncall: Increased mgmt-plane policer for rollout service from 500pps -> 1kpps for 30m (watching host TCP queues).
Leo K: After bump, attestation error rate fell from ~22% -> ~4%, provisioning started freeing GPUs: 96/120 now AVAILABLE.
Sanjay P: Still two hosts with persistent failures; serial console shows BMC reboot loop approx every 25-40s. Suspect flaky BMC firmware + secure-boot state machine.
Marta V: Plan: quarantine those two nodes, mark for HW swap, blacklist from provisioning. Also change rollout policy to 10% batches with 15m holds and add KMS backoff jitter. Creating runbook now.
Marta V: Runbook snippet pasted below:
```# rollback secure-boot toggle and stabilize rollout
1) pause rollout: infractl rollout pause --id 4823
2) bump rollout batch: infractl rollout set --id 4823 --batch-size 10
3) adjust policer: mgmtctl set-policer --service rollout --pps 1000 --duration 30m
4) quarantine nodes: infractl quarantine node-abc123 node-def456 --reason "bmc-reboot-loop"
5) collect SEL/console logs: ipmitool sel elist > /tmp/sel-node.log; socat - /dev/ttyUSB0,raw,echo=0 > /tmp/serial-node.log &
6) attest retry: attestctl retry --rack ap-se2 --count 3 --backoff 5m --jitter 0.3
```
Alejandra: Noted cost delta: increasing policer + extra attest attempts will add ~USD 1.1k/day in mgmt API egress and HSM ops — logging for finance/chargeback.
InfraBot: incident created INC-2026-78 (severity: P2) — assigned: eng-infra oncall.
Marta V: Follow-up: opening vendor ticket for BMC reboot-loop (attached serial logs). For now, quarantined nodes remain offline. I'll update runbooks/firmware/oob-secboot-rollouts.md with the new batch/hold defaults.
Ops Oncall: Monitoring — if we exceed 75% mgmt-plane CPU or sustained retransmits, revert policer to 500pps and slow rollout further.
Leo K: TL;DR — root cause likely combined: policer + KMS rate-limits + a small set of flaky BMCs that, when subject to secure-boot toggles, enter reboot loops. Remediation = pause, increase burst temporarily, quarantine bad BMCs, re-run attestation with jittered retries.
Marta V: Closing thread here; will post runbook PR and postmortem note after vendor response. :white_check_mark:
